claim: _summary
evidence: 19 problems: 4 wrong, 0 outdated, 12 overreach, 0 unsupported, 3 unverifiable. Key issues: (1) Copyright/source rule: the source line links to two third-party copies of paid texts, the Anglia Cargo-hosted IATA DGR 56 2.2 extract (IATA permission 'Provided to Anglia Cargo International Ltd') and the UTIKAD-hosted ICAO Doc 9284 2015-2016 (ICAO 'All rights reserved'). Remove both links and cite by name and edition only. The intro ('IATA·ICAO가 공개한') and disclaimer ('IATA가 허락해 공개된') also overstate their status. (2) Edition labels: section 1 quotes DGR 2.2 and ICAO TI Part 7 in the present tense with no edition, and the warehouse table cites 'ICAO 7 6.1' unlabeled. Elsewhere the draft labels them 56th / 2015-2016 correctly; current DGR 67 / TI 2025-2026 were not checked. (3) 선박입출항법 제32조④ notification is written as import-only ('수입이면', '수입 위험물은'). The article covers 수출·수입 신고 대상 물품의 화주, and 시행규칙 제15조① covers DG brought into the port by land.
